scope: The complete bounded 886-token red-/rěd-/rjad-/ręd- row, series, order and rank census in the four Latin sources after EDIT-0118: 393 selected sites on 286 lines, 488 already-canonical ręd-family controls, and five protected formula abbreviations.
choice: Normalize 356 ordinary legacy row/order inflections to the official type-1 ręd paradigm; repair two malformed rędku row forms to rędu; recast 35 rędny/rędovy/redny/rednost false-friend tokens into explicit series decompositions, determinant or matrix rank phrases, or porędok order language; preserve the five exact mathematical identifiers \rm red.
motivation: Official type-1 ręd covers row, queue, order, arrangement and sequence and already has 488 canonical controls in this edition. Derivatives rędny and rędovy do not mean n-rowed or row-wise: the official entries mean regular and military private. Explicit constructions with ręda preserve the German reihig rank semantics, while razloženje v rędy preserves Reihenentwicklung and porędok preserves Reihenfolge. The five formula tokens are mathematical identifiers, not prose, and therefore remain untouched.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining red-/rěd-/rjad- was rejected because it leaves three mixed source strata beside the established official ręd family.
Blindly changing every red token was rejected because five occurrences are formula identifiers written as \rm red.
Blindly accenting rędny/rędovy derivatives was rejected because their official meanings are regular and military private, not matrix rank or series decomposition.
Using rędny for German reihig was rejected in favor of explicit determinant/matrix + ręda constructions that preserve the mathematical meaning and avoid the false friend.
Retaining rędovo razloženje was rejected because it can read as a private's decomposition; razloženje v rędy states expansion into series directly.
Retaining rednost was rejected because official rędnosť means regularity; the context means in some order and therefore uses v někom porędku.
A cross-span lazy math regex was rejected because it could bridge separate inline-math atoms; every rank recast is exact and bounded.

evidence.official_dictionary: Official isv_words_list.csv, 7993414 bytes, SHA-256 072DE8E512EB386780D199FBD6F0ACF2639D3096EA920F1AF2D0AFCC5535E842: physical row 13986 / ID 2283 gives ręd, type 1, row or queue; row 13987 / ID 3798 gives ręd, type 1, order, arrangement or sequence; row 11714 / ID 3145 gives porędȯk for order. Rows 13999-14002 show why rędnosť, rędny and rędovy are false friends here: regularity, regular and military private.
evidence.official_grammar: Official nouns.md, 12310 bytes, SHA-256 BCE65A602F5DAFFF86BD132C6CBD0F5F1A4D5BDE9750A0394F78E5D4A8E9F09E, governs the regular masculine consonant-stem ręd paradigm used by the direct map.
evidence.german_authority: German ED0014 noether.tex, 2154011 bytes, SHA-256 EE226847656BC4D65EDDA9E9BF9BB1D25797C0C6D672D267D94A97FD88C7AD58: all selected contexts were replayed against Reihe, Reihenfolge, Reihenentwicklung and n-/rho-reihig controls. Representative aligned controls include lines 9205, 10036, 13327, 13722, 16120, 16493, 17786 and 18421.
evidence.semantic_audit: All 393 sites were inspected by complete-family replay. The 356 direct legacy forms denote rows, series or order. The two rędku forms mean each row and therefore take dative/locative rędu, not the separate rędȯk line/verse lemma. The 35 derivative sites divide into eight series-expansion phrases, 26 determinant/matrix rank tokens and one order phrase. No prose target has a different meaning and no linguistic hold remains.
evidence.protected_domains: No selected target lies in comments, foreign/foreignlanguage, URL/href/path, label/ref/pageref/eqref/cite or bibliography-identity payloads. Bibliography targets are translated title text. The five protected red identifiers are exact raw-math controls at base lines 22196, 22198, 22202, 22203 and 22384.
evidence.independent_qa: An independent read-only reviewer reproduced all aggregate and subset receipts, every phrase/rank recast, official and German evidence, formula protection, output hashes, zero residue and structural gates; it reviewed the final 20321-byte applicator and returned ACCEPT with no defect.

phrase_policy.rank: Rewrite MATH-rędny/redny determinant or matrix adjectives as determinant/matrix + ręda MATH, with exact case agreement and exact math atoms preserved.
phrase_policy.order: v někoj rednosti -> v někom porędku

validation.coverage: The broad, target, direct, derived and protected censuses and all ten receipts match the hash-gated EDIT-0118 inputs.
validation.postcondition: All selected source and false-friend derivative shapes are zero; exactly five protected red identifiers remain; the canonical ręd histogram totals 880 and porędku increments by one.
validation.structure: UTF-8 NFC/no-BOM/LF transport, terminal LF, line count, braces, ordered TeX controls, environments, label/ref/cite sequence, math-delimiter stream, exact math-payload multiset, comments and protected payloads are invariant. Only 44, base and bibliography change.
validation.reproducibility: Independent replay reproduces all three changed output hashes and proves Paper 45 byte-identical.
